title: Lakefront Day vertical wall print
story: A Lincoln Park condo owner wanted the summer lakefront on their living-room accent wall year round: the skyline, the trail, sailboats out on the water. We printed the Lakefront Day artwork as a tall 36 by 60 inch panel to fit the narrow wall between two windows. The satin finish holds color depth on the water and sky without going glossy in the afternoon light.

photos.alt: Tall custom wall mural installed on an interior accent wall between two windows
